subject: Mutual Action Plan & discount approval path — Clearwave Health
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Park <danielle@clearwave.health>, Mike Henry <mike.henry@clearwave.health>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clearwave.health>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed MAP and evaluation timeline (first pass)

Hi Danielle / Mike —

Great to meet last week. Per our call, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and evaluation schedule tied to the technical pilot. Key highlights:

- 30-day eval starting Feb 1 with access to Redwood hosted API (100k tokens/day)
- Ramp milestones at 30/60/90 days tied to commit volumes (see page 2)
- Conditional commercial terms: 15% strategic discount at signed 12-month commit (>= $120k ARR), plus accelerated ramp credits if they hit 60% commit by day 60

We want to be explicit about the tie between the milestones and the discount to avoid surprises during procurement. I’ve also attached an SOW draft to speed legal.

Can you confirm the timeline and whether procurement needs a different cadence? If you want, we can add a short onboarding week prior to Feb 1.

Next step: I’ll send an internal approval request for the discount path early next week and loop finance.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: Clearwave_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP, 3 pages), SOW_Clearwave_draft.docx (SOW draft)
From: Mike Henry <mike.henry@clearwave.health>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Park <danielle@clearwave.health>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clearwave.health>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP and evaluation timeline (first pass)

Laura —

Thanks for the MAP. High level looks great. Couple of asks from procurement/business:

1) Can Clearwave get a firm 20% discount if we commit to a 12-month $150k ARR minimum? Our team is under budget pressure and the extra headroom would justify faster signoff.
2) We’d like the pilot acceptance criteria tightened (see inline comments in your MAP).
3) Can you move the pilot start to Feb 8 to accommodate our security review?

If you can get a 20% commitment and confirm updated acceptance criteria, we’ll push to have procurement ready the week of Feb 1.

Regards,
Mike

Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Clearwave MAP — customer asking for 20% for $150k ARR commit (need approval path)

Team —

Clearing house: Clearwave (prospect) asked for a 20% up-front commercial concession in exchange for a signed 12-month $150k ARR (they also want pilot pushed to Feb 8). My recommended counter: 18% with a staged credit schedule tied to MAP milestones (10% on signature, additional 4% at 60-day ramp, 4% at 90-day commit). That preserves revenue recognition while rewarding execution.

Why this matters: They’re an enterprise health-tech customer with an aggressive timeline. If we hold to 15% they may walk to competitor. If we go to 20% unconditional we increase churn/risk.

Request: Can I get approval to offer the staged 18% structure? Need VP + finance/CFO sign-off for anything above 15% per policy.

Attached: redlined_terms.pdf with the staged-credit language.

Thanks,
Laura

Attachments: redlined_terms.pdf

Subject: Re: FW: Clearwave MAP — customer asking for 20% for $150k ARR commit (need approval path)

Laura —

Agree with staged approach. Please include explicit success metrics for the 60-day checkpoint (token consumption threshold + uptime SLA for integration) so finance can forecast credit exposure. Also confirm whether credits are one-time or amortized over the first 3 invoices.

@Evelyn — can you weigh in on go/no-go? If you sign off, we’ll route to Rishi/Vivek for final OK.

Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Clearwave MAP — customer asking for 20% for $150k ARR commit (need approval path)

+1 to staged 18% structure provided:
- 10% signing credit (applied to first invoice)
- 4% credit applied when 60-day ramp >= 60% of committed ARR
- 4% credit applied at 90-day commit verified

Please make the 60-day metric precise (e.g., 60% of committed monthly tokens for two consecutive weeks). Credits should be one-time and reflected as invoice credits (not stepped list price change).

We should be conservative on acceptance criteria but flexible on pilot start date (Feb 8 ok). Laura, get procurement language clarified and then route to Rishi for exposure calc.

Evelyn
VP Sales
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearwave MAP — final approval for staged discount

Laura / team —

Reviewed the staged 18% structure and the exposure calc from Rishi. We will approve the concession under the following conditions:

- Discount structure must be implemented as one-time invoice credits and capped at the agreed amounts (10% +4%+4%).
- SOW must include the explicit 60-day metric: 60% of committed monthly tokens for two consecutive weeks.
- Legal to confirm limitation-of-liability language unchanged and no changes to data residency clauses.
- Finance to reserve a $18k credit liability bucket against the account (Rishi will handle).

With those conditions met, CFO sign-off is granted. Laura, please update the MAP/SOW files and send the final to procurement (cc: Rishi for billing schedule).

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Financial Officer | Redwood Inference

Thank you for the fast follow. Per our internal approvals, Redwood can offer the staged 18% total concession tied to the MAP milestones as discussed: 10% signing credit (first invoice), +4% at verified 60-day ramp, +4% at 90-day commit. We have updated the MAP and SOW (attached) with tightened acceptance criteria and the explicit 60-day metric. Pilot start moved to Feb 8 as requested.

Next steps:
- Please review attached final MAP (Clearwave_MAP_v3.pdf) and SOW_Clearwave_draft.docx redlines and confirm via reply by Jan 25.
- Once we have confirmation, we’ll send the signature-ready DocuSign and reserve the pilot slots.

Best,
Laura
